title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 1: God speaking through the prophets and then by his Son, the Son seated at the right hand, and what is said of the angels.

questions.text: Through whom did God speak to the fathers in the past?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that God spoke to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways.

questions.text: By whom has God spoken to us at the end of these days?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that at the end of these days God has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things.

questions.text: Where did the Son sit down after he had purified us of our sins?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that when he had by himself purified us of our sins, he sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high.

answers.text: On the right hand of the Majesty
In the house of the fathers
At the gate of the city

questions.text: Than whom has he become much better, having inherited a more excellent name?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he has become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

questions.text: What is said when he again brings the firstborn into the world?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that when he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, "Let all the angels of God worship him."

answers.text: "Let all the angels of God worship him."
"Let the heavens tell of his glory."
"Let the earth keep silent before him."
"Let the kings of the earth fear him."

questions.text: What does he say of the angels in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says of the angels that he makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.

answers.text: That he hides them in light

questions.text: How long is the Son's throne said to last?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says of the Son, "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever," and that the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of his Kingdom.

questions.text: With what has God anointed the one who loved righteousness and hated iniquity?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that because he loved righteousness and hated iniquity, God has anointed him with the oil of gladness above his fellows.

questions.text: What does the text say will happen to the heavens, the works of his hands?
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 say they will perish and all grow old like a garment, and will be rolled up like a mantle and changed, while he remains the same.

answers.text: They will grow old like a garment
They will shine brighter than fire
They will be hidden for a time

questions.text: What does verse 14 call the angels?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 asks whether they are not all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation.
